violations.text: Refried beans observed to be dated 9/15/2026. This has exceeded to 7-day limit for food safety. Beans were voluntarily disposed of during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

The doors to the outside, located in the receiving area, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2026

The doors to the outside, located beside the mop sink area, are not tight-fitting. Space observed between the 2 doors at the bottom. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 03/20/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment has employees certified through an approved course in food safety management. One of these employees must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 10/17/2025

The door to the outside, located in the back hallway of the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2023
